why: Martí-Pete, Rempe and Waterman constructed a counterexample to Eremenko's conjecture (a transcendental entire function with a bounded escaping-set component); the arXiv preprint (2108.10256) dates to August 2021, pre-snapshot, but the paper was formally published in J. Amer. Math. Soc. 38 (2025), 877-918, so the Wikipedia entry appears stale.
